metadata.purpose: Prove that a remote external process can change objective passability without creating player knowledge or a message.
startingKnowledge: Only the expedition start is confirmed; the remote route location and its collapse are unknown.
metadata.expectedWorldProcess: An authored external-route-collapse trigger blocks the source tile silently after one day.
metadata.outstandingDecisionPoint: There is no player-facing decision until the change is plausibly observed later.
